funds_data.description: The fund seeks to track the investment results of the S&P 500 3% Capped Index (the “underlying index”), which is based on a float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted parent index, the S&P 500 (the “Parent Index”). he Parent Index is designed to measure the performance of the large-capitalization segment of the U.S. equity market, as determined by the S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC (the “index provider” or “SPDJI”). The fund is non-diversified.
